# Copilot instructions for R2D2BC-cada

This is the JavaScript/TypeScript reader library consumed by react-leser. It may be upgraded from upstream later, so keep fork-specific changes small, isolated, and easy to carry forward. Preserve upstream structure and public API behavior unless the requested fix requires a change; document non-obvious deviations. Add focused tests for changed behavior. Avoid unrelated refactors and formatting churn.
